findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung begin affirming that they can manage, but the narration explicitly says he was about to answer that it was impossible.
findings.rationale: The interrupted wording must remain incomplete so that it can lead into Taekyung’s stated intention to say 불가능하다고.

findings.defect: Wolhwa’s response accepting the apology and conceding that Jin Mukyung is correct is omitted, weakening both her characterization and the humor of the exchange.
findings.rationale: The source preserves Wolhwa’s lightly amused composure while confirming that Mukyung’s blunt assessment is accurate.
findings.replacement:
“…I apologize for that.”

“Well, that’s all right. You’re not wrong.”

findings.current: It was one of only three rare treasures Pung Yang possessed. Using one had allowed him to defeat Cheol Mubaek, but the aftereffects were considerable.
findings.defect: The draft says the pill was one item among three rare treasures, rather than saying Pung Yang possessed only three of these pills.
findings.rationale: 세 개밖에 없는 refers to the quantity of Temporary Strength Pills, which matters because he later consumes another one.
findings.replacement: Even Pung Yang possessed only three of these precious pills. Using one had allowed him to defeat Cheol Mubaek, but the aftereffects were considerable.
findings.source: 풍양에게도 고작 세 개밖에 없는 귀물이다. 그중 하나를 쓴 덕분에 철무백을 쓰러트릴 수 있었지만 후유증이 제법 컸다.

findings.current: Even though the sect had suffered heavy losses, it didn’t matter.
findings.defect: The draft explicitly assigns the losses to the Mount Heng Sword Sect even though the Korean leaves the affected party unstated.
findings.rationale: Both the sect and Pung Yang’s forces have sustained losses, so the source’s omitted subject should remain ambiguous.
findings.replacement: Though there had been heavy losses, it didn’t matter.

findings.current: Jin Mukyung, the Heaven Shaking Sword. A genius who had reached the Peak realm at barely twenty years of age.
findings.defect: “Barely twenty” presents Jin Mukyung as approximately twenty, conflicting with his established age of twenty-three; 약관 is being used broadly for his early twenties here.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the source’s emphasis on his exceptional youth without introducing an incorrect specific age.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung, the Heaven Shaking Sword. A genius who had reached the Peak realm while still in his early twenties.
findings.source: 진천검 진무경. 불과 약관의 나이에 절정의 경지에 오른 천재.

findings.current: His limbs were twisted at unnatural angles, and the black blood soaking his upper body was proof of severe internal injuries.
findings.defect: The blood is soaking Cheol Mubaek’s upper garment, not his upper body directly.
findings.rationale: 상의 denotes the clothing worn on the upper body.
findings.replacement: His limbs were twisted at unnatural angles, and the black blood soaking his shirt was proof of severe internal injuries.
findings.source: 기이한 방향으로 꺾여 있는 사지, 상의를 흠뻑 적신 검은 핏물은 심각한 내상의 증거다.

findings.defect: The wording is unnatural and misreads 웃기는 as genuinely humorous rather than dismissively calling Taekyung ridiculous.
findings.rationale: In this exchange, 웃기는 놈 is a curt expression of incredulity or contempt, not praise for being amusing.

findings.defect: This is an unnatural literal rendering of an idiom describing someone who speaks glibly or fluently.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys Mukyung’s dry observation that Taekyung always has a smooth answer ready.
findings.replacement: “You certainly have a way with words.”

findings.current: He hid his trembling hands beneath his sleeves and said,
findings.defect: The draft omits the source’s comparison of Pung Yang’s shaking hands to an aspen.
findings.rationale: The simile emphasizes the severity of the pill’s aftereffects and is concrete source imagery.
findings.replacement: He hid his hands, trembling like aspen leaves, beneath his sleeves and said,
findings.source: 그는 사시나무처럼 떨리는 손을 소매 아래로 감추며 말했다.

findings.current: *If the Blood Wolf Sword could do the same thing thirty years ago, why couldn’t I?*
findings.defect: The draft turns the approximate quantity 삼십여 년 into an exact thirty years.
findings.rationale: 삼십여 년 means thirty-some or over thirty years, not exactly thirty.
findings.replacement: *If the Blood Wolf Sword could do the same thing over thirty years ago, why couldn’t I?*
findings.source: ‘삼십여 년 전 혈랑검도 했던 일을 내가 못 하랴.’

findings.current: A young man dressed in black as dark as night was walking toward them from more than fifty jang away.[^2]
findings.defect: The draft renders the approximate distance 오십여 장 as strictly more than fifty jang.
findings.rationale: 오십여 장 indicates roughly fifty jang rather than a lower bound exceeding fifty.
findings.replacement: A young man dressed in black as dark as night was walking toward them from some fifty jang away.[^2]
findings.source: 밤처럼 새카만 흑의(黑衣)를 걸친 청년이 오십여 장 밖에서 걸어오고 있었다.

summary: The draft contains one reversed line of dialogue, one omitted response, several altered quantities or subjects, and localized fidelity and natural-English issues.
